newsitem.title: USA: Digi cuts Fast Ethernet prices.
newsitem.headline: Digi cuts Fast Ethernet prices.

text.p: Digi International Inc said Wednesday it cut its worldwide retail prices for Fast Ethernet connectivity products by up to 30 percent.
Digi said the move establishes its price leadership in the Fast Ethernet marketplace and positions it to increase its market share in the networking connectivity arena.
Digi said the new U.S. list price on its 180T/C UTP-to-fiber media converter is $775, compared with the old list price of $995.

"This price reduction signals Digi's intent to provide the most cost-effective connectivity solutions in the Fast Ethernet marketplace," Jerry Dusa, vice president, said in a statement. "As part of Digi's commitment to supply our customers with attractively priced solutions, we will continue to expand our Fast Ethernet product line to meet their growing needs for increased bandwidth."
The Fast Ethernet products are used to connect computers in Ethernet local area networks.
